name: autonomous-factory

myAi.defaultModel.description: Legacy global default model name. Prefer myAi.models.<provider> for coherent per-provider defaults.

myAi.models.openai.description: Default model when the OpenAI provider is selected.

myAi.models.ollama.description: Default model when the Ollama provider is selected.

myAi.models.anthropic.description: Default Claude model id for the Anthropic provider.

myAi.models.openaiCompat.description: Default model id for local OpenAI-compatible (vLLM, etc.) endpoints.

myAi.models.vscodeLm.description: Optional hint to match a VS Code LM id/family when multiple models exist.

myAi.openaiCompat.baseUrl.description: Base URL for local OpenAI-compatible servers (vLLM, llama.cpp server, etc.).

myAi.useNativeChatParticipant.description: Register a native VS Code chat participant when available.

myAi.missions.autoResumeOnStartup.description: Resume running or queued missions on startup.

myAi.missions.maxStepsPerRun.description: Safety cap for autonomous steps in one run.

myAi.missions.heartbeatSeconds.description: Background runner heartbeat interval in seconds.

myAi.missions.diskStoreFolder.description: Workspace-relative folder for mission files and approval previews.

myAi.missions.toolResultSpill.enabled.description: When true, large tool result payloads in mission events are written under the disk store folder and referenced inline to keep mission JSON smaller.

myAi.missions.toolResultSpill.maxInlineB.description: If serialized event data exceeds this UTF-8 byte size, spill to disk (when enabled and a workspace folder exists).

myAi.tools.showDiffBeforeApproval.description: Open a diff preview before approving writeFile/applyPatch actions.

myAi.missions.portableJson.description: Persist missions as portable JSON files under the workspace folder.

myAi.missions.autoCheckpointEveryStep.description: Persist a checkpoint after each step.

myAi.tools.requireApprovalForWrite.description: When true, mutating writeFile/applyPatch calls require operator approval before the tool runs (subject to requireApprovalForInWorkspaceWrites for paths inside the workspace).

myAi.tools.requireApprovalForInWorkspace.description: When true (default), workspace-path writeFile/applyPatch also require approval. Set false to allow autonomous in-workspace writes while restrictToWorkspace keeps paths bounded.

myAi.tools.requireApprovalForTerminal.description: Require approval before runTerminal tool calls.

myAi.skills.enabled.description: Load markdown from myAi.skills.globPatterns and inject into agent system prompts (bounded size).

myAi.skills.globPatterns.description: Workspace-relative globs for skill markdown files.

myAi.skills.maxTotalChars.description: Maximum total characters injected from all skill files per agent turn.

myAi.skills.maxCharsPerFile.description: Maximum characters read from each skill file.

myAi.webResearch.enabled.description: Enable webSearch and fetchWebPage tools (HTTP; uses same approval policy as httpRequest).

myAi.webSearch.provider.description: webSearch backend: duckduckgo (instant answer API; fair use) or brave (Brave Search API). For brave, use Command Palette → Autonomous Factory: Set Brave Search API Key (stores myAi.webSearch.braveApiKey in Secret Storage).

myAi.webSearch.minIntervalMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between webSearch HTTP requests after approval (0 = disabled). Reduces load on the search API.

myAi.webResearch.maxCallsPerMission.description: Maximum successful webSearch/fetchWebPage network calls per mission (0 = unlimited). When exceeded, the tool fails with guidance to reuse memory/cache instead of operator approval.

myAi.webResearch.skipHttpApproval.description: When true, webSearch and fetchWebPage bypass the global myAi.tools.requireApprovalForHttp gate (role envelopes and other policy still apply). The generic httpRequest tool is unchanged.

myAi.webResearch.unlimitedBudgetForLocal.description: When true and the provider for the current work item resolves to local (workItem.providerId, else routing.providerPerRole[role], else mission active provider; see localLlmProviderIds), the extension skips paid-API-style web limits: webSearch/fetchWebPage call caps and webSearch minIntervalMs. Use mixed routing (e.g. planner cloud + implementer local) and attributed tool calls (__workItemId) so each role is judged correctly.

myAi.webResearch.localLlmProviderIds.description: Comma/space-separated mission provider ids (activeProviderId when the mission starts) treated as “local LLM” for unlimitedBudgetForLocalLlm. Default: ollama.

myAi.webResearch.cacheEnabled.description: Cache successful webSearch/fetchWebPage results within a mission to reduce repeated network calls.

myAi.webResearch.cacheTtlMs.description: Time-to-live for cached webSearch/fetchWebPage results (ms). When stale, the tool refetches and logs a warning.

myAi.webResearch.warnStaleEvidenceOnMuta.description: When true (balanced/strict missions), warn if mission memory still contains web research evidence past its freshness TTL when an implementer performs a mutating change.

myAi.browser.enabled.description: Enable browserCapture tool (runs myAi.browser.captureCommand; no browser bundled in the extension).

myAi.browser.captureCommand.description: Shell command template with {url} and {outPath} (e.g. npx playwright screenshot {url} {outPath}). Values are single-quoted. Requires Playwright or similar on PATH.

myAi.browser.captureMaxOutputBytes.description: Max stdout+stderr bytes captured for browserCapture.

myAi.browser.captureFileExtension.description: File extension for capture output under diskStoreFolder/browser-captures/.

myAi.memory.maxRecentEvents.description: Maximum recent memory events stored per mission.

myAi.memory.semanticRecallLimit.description: Maximum semantic memory items recalled into an agent turn.

myAi.missions.closureRequired.description: Keep missions alive until validation passes or a real blocker is recorded.

myAi.missions.requireReviewerBeforeCompl.description: Require at least one reviewer step before a closure-required mission completes.

myAi.missions.requireValidatorBeforeComp.description: Require validator sign-off before a closure-required mission completes.

myAi.missions.maxAutoRounds.description: Maximum autonomous rounds before the mission is paused as blocked for operator review.

myAi.memory.enableGlobalSemanticMemory.description: Persist memory across missions and use it for semantic recall.

myAi.memory.globalRecallLimit.description: Maximum global semantic memory items recalled into an agent turn.

myAi.tools.externalAdaptersFile.description: Workspace-relative JSON file defining external tool adapters.

myAi.tools.requireApprovalForExternal.description: Require approval before calling a mutating external tool adapter.

myAi.tools.listToolsHintsMaxChars.description: Maximum characters for the listTools `hints` array (one-line usage per tool). Set to 0 to omit hints and keep only builtin names + external adapters.

myAi.tools.listToolsRedactExternalUrls.description: When true, listTools omits url and headers from the `external` array (and sets externalUrlsRedacted). Hints still work; use adapters.json on disk for full URLs.

myAi.tools.listMcpToolsSummaryMaxChars.description: When > 0, listMcpTools strips inputSchema, adds inputPropertyNames from schema properties when available, trims descriptions, and fits JSON.stringify(data) to this budget; may drop trailing tools and append __myAi__.list_budget. 0 = full MCP descriptors (legacy).

myAi.missions.requireImplementerBeforeCo.description: Require at least one implementer step before closure-required missions can complete.

myAi.missions.minCompletedWorkItems.description: Minimum completed work items before a closure-required mission may complete.

myAi.missions.stallReplanThreshold.description: If too few todo items remain before closure, enqueue an automatic re-plan after this many rounds without progress.

myAi.tools.requireApprovalForMcp.description: Require approval before MCP tool calls.

myAi.tools.requireApprovalForHttp.description: Require approval before httpRequest tool calls.

myAi.tools.restrictToWorkspace.description: Restrict file tools to workspace-contained paths.

myAi.tools.commandOutputMaxBytes.description: Maximum bytes of stdout/stderr captured per runCommand invocation. Output beyond this limit is truncated.

myAi.tools.commandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for runCommand tool calls. Individual calls can override this.

myAi.providers.maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts for transient provider failures.

myAi.providers.retryDelayMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds between provider retries.

myAi.mcp.configPath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to MCP server config JSON.

myAi.missions.stallHeartbeatThreshold.description: Number of heartbeats with no progress before the runner injects a recovery replan.

myAi.missions.maxStallAutoReplans.description: Maximum automatic recovery replans before a mission is marked blocked for operator review.

myAi.missions.scalingMode.description: How mission step/round limits scale. 'fixed' uses config values directly. 'adaptive' scales limits based on work item count.

myAi.missions.maxAutoRetries.description: Maximum automatic retries for failed work items. Set 0 to disable. Retries inject error context so the agent can try a different approach.

myAi.missions.markDeadLetterAfterRetryEx.description: When automatic retries are exhausted (or max is 0), mark the failed work item as dead letter, append operator guidance to output, and emit an error event.

myAi.missions.claimDiscipline.description: Inject claim-discipline instructions so agents can record VERIFIED_* vs ASSUMPTION via MEMORY lines.

myAi.missions.trustGates.enabled.description: When true, dependency-style shell commands and very large patches (after many file touches) require operator approval unless a recent verified MEMORY claim exists.

myAi.missions.trustGates.largePatchMinCh.description: Minimum search+replace character total to treat an applyPatch as 'large' for trust gating (with many files touched).

myAi.missions.trustGates.manyModifiedFil.description: Mission filesModified count at or above which large patches trigger the trust gate (when enabled).

myAi.missions.adaptiveMaxRounds.description: Hard cap for adaptive scaling mode.

myAi.missions.adaptiveFailurePenaltyRoun.description: In adaptive scaling, subtract this many effective rounds per failed or dead-letter queue row.

myAi.missions.adaptiveLoopGuardPenaltyRo.description: In adaptive scaling, subtract this many effective rounds per runtime.loopGuardTrips (stall/max-round trips).

myAi.context.relevantSnippetsCacheTtlMs.description: TTL (ms) for caching keyword→relevant-file snippets in EnhancedContextCollector; 0 disables cache.

myAi.tools.searchFilesMaxResults.description: Max ripgrep matches per searchFiles / grepSearch tool call (agent requests are capped to this).

myAi.missions.gitCheckpointBeforeImpl.description: Automatically git-stash before implementer work items and restore on failure. Requires a git repository in the workspace.

myAi.missions.maxToolFollowUpTurns.description: Maximum number of follow-up turns where tool results are fed back to the agent for iterative refinement. Set to 0 to disable tool follow-up loops.

myAi.mcp.persistSessions.description: Keep MCP stdio servers alive across calls instead of spawning per request.

myAi.mcp.sessionWarmupOnStartup.description: Warm configured MCP sessions on startup.

myAi.mcp.sessionWarmupStaggerMs.description: When sessionWarmupOnStartup is true, wait this many milliseconds between starting each server (0 = no delay). Spreads process spawn load.

myAi.mcp.toolCacheTtlSeconds.description: How long to cache MCP tool descriptors per live session.

myAi.missions.policyPreset.description: Default closure policy preset for new missions.

myAi.missions.requireValidationEvidence.description: Require explicit validation evidence before a closure-required mission can complete.

myAi.memory.minSemanticScore.description: Minimum semantic similarity score for memory recall results.

myAi.embeddings.useRealEmbeddings.description: Use real embedding models for semantic memory search. Falls back to local FNV-1a hashing when disabled or unavailable.

myAi.embeddings.provider.description: Provider to use for real embedding requests.

myAi.embeddings.model.description: Model name for embedding requests (OpenAI-compatible providers).

myAi.embeddings.ollamaModel.description: Model name for Ollama embedding requests.

myAi.missions.requirePlannerCoverage.description: Require planner-generated role coverage (implementer/reviewer/validator) before closure.

myAi.missions.blueprintMode.description: When true, new missions start with a full JSON blueprint planner pass; approve before synthesized work runs.

myAi.missions.preBlueprintClarification.description: When blueprint mode is on, run one planner pass first that outputs structured clarification questions; operator answers in the missions inspector (or command), then blueprint JSON is generated with Q&A in context.

myAi.missions.requireBlueprintApproval.description: Pause after blueprint generation until operator approves (when blueprintMode is on).

myAi.missions.maxBlueprintSteps.description: Maximum steps accepted in a parsed mission blueprint.

myAi.missions.maxBlueprintRevisions.description: Max operator-requested blueprint revision rounds per mission.

myAi.missions.architectPassAfterValidato.description: When true and blueprint is approved, enqueue an architect gap review after each validator COMPLETE.

myAi.missions.blueprintFidelityCheck.description: When true, after each successful implementer step on an approved blueprint mission, flush file tracker and enqueue an optional reviewer if modified paths do not match blueprint-derived keywords (heuristic; allowlists common config files).

myAi.missions.verification.autoRunLinter.description: When true, balanced/strict mission policy automatically runs the linter after implementer mutations (Verifier Mesh obligation).

myAi.missions.verification.autoRunTestsA.description: When true, balanced/strict mission policy automatically runs tests after implementer mutations (Verifier Mesh obligation).

myAi.missions.pauseAfterEachValidator.description: When true, after each validator work item completes successfully, pause the mission (awaiting_input) until the operator runs Autonomous Factory: Resume Mission.

myAi.reviewers.autoCreateFixTasks.description: When reviewer output reports issues without an implementer follow-up, automatically inject remediation/re-review/re-validation tasks.

myAi.agents.routingPreset.description: Default agent routing preset for new missions.

myAi.approvals.bundleAutoSummary.description: Enable summary documents for approval bundles.

myAi.ui.dashboardPollIntervalMs.description: Interval for automatic sidebar snapshot refresh while the webview is visible. Lower values increase extension-host CPU, disk, and MCP traffic.

myAi.ui.traceAutoRefreshIntervalMs.description: Interval (ms) for Trace tab auto-refresh when enabled. Higher values reduce host/webview traffic.

myAi.ui.retainWebviewContextWhenHidden.description: Keep the sidebar webview JavaScript heap when the view is hidden (smoother tab switches; more memory). Set false to reduce memory at the cost of full reload when reopening.

myAi.ui.autoRevealOnActivation.description: Automatically reveal the Autonomous Factory sidebar when the extension activates.

myAi.ui.defaultTab.description: Default tab shown when the Autonomous Factory sidebar loads.

myAi.agents.maxPromptChars.description: Maximum characters for the prompt sent to the LLM. Sections are progressively trimmed when exceeding 80% of this budget.

myAi.agents.lazyToolPrompt.description: Use a shorter TOOL cheat sheet in the user prompt; agents should call listTools and listMcpTools to discover git, docker, http, webSearch, and other builtins. Saves context tokens.

myAi.agents.enforceDefaultCodingStandard.description: Inject shared modularity / structure guidance into planner (non-blueprint), implementer, reviewer, and architect prompts.

myAi.agents.goalFirstDiscipline.description: Inject goal-first execution discipline into all mission agents (system + user tool prompt): clarify end-state, compare viable approaches before non-trivial implementation, then execute. Operators do not need to repeat this in mission text.

myAi.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to include in the workspace semantic index.

myAi.index.includeGlobs.description: Glob patterns for files to include in the workspace index.

myAi.index.excludeGlobs.description: Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude from the workspace index.

myAi.index.buildOnActivation.description: When true, scan and index workspace files as soon as the extension activates. When false (default), indexing starts on first use (e.g. findRelevantFiles) to speed up startup.

myAi.index.incrementalSaveDebounceMs.description: Debounce window (ms) for re-indexing a file after save. Coalesces rapid saves.

myAi.trace.level.description: Maximum verbosity for the unified Autonomous Factory Trace output channel. error = errors only; info = operator-friendly; debug/trace = more host/webview detail.

myAi.trace.persistToFile.description: Append JSON trace lines to globalStorage/trace/my-ai-trace-append.jsonl (in addition to the output channel).

scripts.lint: npm run compile && npx eslint src/ --ext .ts
scripts.test: npm run compile && node scripts/sync-dist-tests.mjs && node --require ./scripts/vscode-test-shim.cjs --test dist/test/**/*.test.js && node --test scripts/webview-modular-smoke.mjs
